correctness.rationale: PASS: For every odd prime p the involution k->p-1-k and product formula for coefficients of D_k(x) give coefficientwise p-divisibility of the whole defect H_p. Exact alternating-sum identities give h_0=0, h_1=4p^3, and p^3|h_2,h_3 including p=3,5 exceptions. At x with v_p(x)=h>=1, degree>=4 terms have valuation >=1+4h>=h+4 and degrees 2,3 have >=3+2h, giving H_p(x) congruent 4p^3x mod p^(h+4); odd p implies exact valuation h+3. Legendre symmetry D_k(-1-x)=(-1)^k D_k(x), and the even fourth power plus invariance of x(x+1),(2x+1)^2, establish the reflection branch near -1. Independently evaluated exact defects for p=3,5,7,11,13 and depths 1..3 with unit multipliers and reflected values; checked exceptional low coefficients. x=0,-1 have H=0, not finite valuation. No statement at other residues.
